lines.en: I swim through the deep.
My lure sways ahead of me.
I sink toward the bottom.
I move with sweeps of my tail.
I swim off into the darkness.

lines.zh: 发光的鱼饵，能酿夜视药。
lines.en: This glowing lure brews night vision.
I travel along the seafloor.
My lure pulses on and off.
I head toward any shadow.
I swim rather slowly.
I look up at the light above.
I slip down the trench's edge.
I turn toward the smallest stir.
My fins fan slowly.
I follow a cold current.
That lure of mine is lit.
I wait for a fish.
My teeth look pale in the dark.
I barely move my tail.
The deep sea is utterly quiet.

lines.zh: 我的灯是我唯一的记号
lines.en: My lure is my only mark.
I sank a little.
What I wait for has not come.
My gill cover opens and closes.
I breathe sparingly.
I keep in the reef's shadow.
I listen to the tremors in the water.
You swim slower than a fish.
My lure is lighting you up.
My two eyes sit on either side of my head.
You should not come this deep.
My teeth do not close.
Keep still; I swim slowly.
I know that taste.
My light is on — still watching me?
One tail-lash churned the water.
I shrank back into the dark.
My blood is in the water.
I cannot cry; water swallows it.

lines.zh: 这一下让我偏了方向，诱饵灯还亮着。
lines.en: That knocked me off course; my lure still glows.
My lure sways faster.
My mouth is still open.
That one landed solid.
Is that a fish?
This one is far too small.
That thing in your hand is moving.
I swim toward it.
Does it glow?
I do not eat what is already dead.
Put it in the water.
It is not moving at all.
I only want what moves.
Put it back in your pocket.
You swam into my mouth.
You hit my fin.
We met slowly.
You pulled back a little.
The water clouded.
My teeth scraped your armor.
I did not give chase.
I stirred the bottom under you.
Do not swim this close.
My kind are few down here.
My lure is for finding.
I swim slowly; I cannot find any.
This is not a good time.
That is not your concern.
I head deeper.
I cannot even light myself.
Swim away from here.
No answer comes in the water.
It is stuck in my teeth.
I toss my head and fling it off.
It has sunk to the bottom.
I cannot catch up with it.
My fins are poor at gripping.
Reach in and take it.
My teeth have marked it.

lines.zh: 把我捞上来？你会后悔的。
lines.en: Haul me up? You'll regret it.
Something is moving there.
I head for that shadow.
My lure has lit up.
It is bigger than a fish.
I am not fussy about size at all.
It has not noticed me.
One bite is quite enough.

lines.zh: 找到你了，深海里没有藏身处。
lines.en: Found you — the deep gives no hiding place.
I follow along slowly.
Its shadow is ahead.
My lure is the bait.
It is coming toward the light.
The current brings it closer.
My mouth is nearly there.
I need only one bite.
It has come to a stop.
I wait for it to come nearer.
My whole jaw closes.
The teeth have closed.
My jaws closed on you whole.
My teeth curve inward.
Once I bite, I never let go.
This bite comes heavy.
You tore yourself free.
My lure still sways.
One more bite.
Blood is in the water.
I rise from the deep water.
My lure shows in the dark first.
One more light in the deep.
I drift out from behind the reef.
I swim toward your light.
My teeth stand out in the dark.

lines.zh: 你听见嘴里合上的声音吗
lines.en: Did you hear the jaw close?
I come up out of the trench.
Heat in the water is wrong.
I dropped onto the seafloor.
I am in water, yet I feel smothered.
The spell put out my lure.
There are no fish left in the deep.
Lightning burned through the water.
There is not a drop of water here.
